description: Fork of exp027 with bit_lut_weight_decay 1.0 → 0.3. exp027 stalled at 2.38 bpb @ step 800 — wd=1.0 nukes latents faster than data gradient can re-establish them. wd=0.3 gives gentler relaxation: per-step shrink ≈ 3e-4 at peak lr; over 8k steps cumulative decay factor ≈ 0.09 — wrong-sign latents reach gate-amplifying region near end of training rather than instantly. If this also stalls, the 'saturated init + WD' hypothesis is dead and we revert to standard init.
